senses.gloss: m. (= זהזה, v. זהה) [the glittering, cmp. אִיסָר, אִסְתִּירָא &c.) Zuz,
a silver coin, one fourth of a Shekel, = דִּינָר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 1:5">Keth. I, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זוּזִים</he>, <cite ref="G00150"><he>זוּזִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 22:8">Num. R. s. 22</cite>, end, a. e., v. <cite ref="G00145"><he>זוּז</he> I</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:8">Ter. X, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:1">Tosef. ib. IX, 1</cite> (Var. <cite ref="G00375"><he>זִין</he></cite>); Y. ib. X, 47ᵇ top <cite ref="G00375"><he>זִין</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>זוּזִים</he>. Tosef. l. c. ed. Zuck.; Y. l. c. <he>זִינִין</he>.
